===== C:\Users\Purvi\Desktop\f\biteverse\apps\api\src\middleware\requireAdmin.ts =====
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from "express";
import { HttpError } from "../lib/errors.js";
import { requireAuth } from "./auth.js";

// Logs the user in first, then allows only admins through.
export function requireAdmin(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
  requireAuth(req, res, (err?: unknown) => {
    if (err) return next(err);
    if (req.user?.role !== "admin") return next(new HttpError(403, "Admin access only"));
    next();
  });
}

import { Router } from "express";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { HttpError } from "../../lib/errors.js";
import { requireAdmin } from "../../middleware/requireAdmin.js";
import { Order } from "./order.model.js";
import { ORDER_STATUSES, canTransition, isOrderStatus, type OrderStatus } from "./order.state.js";

export const adminOrderRouter = Router();
adminOrderRouter.use(requireAdmin);

adminOrderRouter.get("/orders", async (req, res) => {
  const status = req.query.status;
  const filter = typeof status === "string" && isOrderStatus(status) ? { status } : {};
  const orders = await Order.find(filter)
    .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
    .limit(200)
    .populate("userId", "name email phone")
    .lean();
  res.json({ orders });
});

adminOrderRouter.patch("/orders/:id/status", async (req, res) => {
  const id = String(req.params.id);
  if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(id)) throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid order id");
  const next = req.body?.status;
  if (!isOrderStatus(next)) throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid status");

  const order = await Order.findById(id);
  if (!order) throw new HttpError(404, "Order not found");
  if (!canTransition(order.status as OrderStatus, next, order.mode)) {
    throw new HttpError(409, `Cannot move an order from ${order.status} to ${next}`);
  }

  // The status condition makes this safe if two admins click at the same moment.
  const updated = await Order.findOneAndUpdate(
    { _id: id, status: order.status },
    { $set: { status: next } },
    { new: true },
  );
  if (!updated) throw new HttpError(409, "Order was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.");
  res.json({ order: updated });
});

adminOrderRouter.get("/stats", async (_req, res) => {
  const startOfDay = new Date();
  startOfDay.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  const [grouped, today] = await Promise.all([
    Order.aggregate<{ _id: string; count: number }>([{ $group: { _id: "$status", count: { $sum: 1 } } }]),
    Order.aggregate<{ orders: number; revenueInr: number }>([
      { $match: { createdAt: { $gte: startOfDay } } },
      { $group: { _id: null, orders: { $sum: 1 }, revenueInr: { $sum: "$totalInr" } } },
    ]),
  ]);
  const byStatus: Record<string, number> = Object.fromEntries(ORDER_STATUSES.map((s) => [s, 0]));
  for (const g of grouped) byStatus[g._id] = g.count;
  res.json({
    byStatus,
    total: Object.values(byStatus).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0),
    today: { orders: today[0]?.orders ?? 0, revenueInr: today[0]?.revenueInr ?? 0 },
  });
});

import { Router } from "express";
import mongoose from "mongoose";
import { HttpError } from "../../lib/errors.js";
import { requireAdmin } from "../../middleware/requireAdmin.js";
import { Restaurant } from "./restaurant.model.js";

export const adminMenuRouter = Router();
adminMenuRouter.use(requireAdmin);

// Accepts only the fields it knows about. `partial` allows a PATCH to send just some of them.
function cleanItem(body: any, partial = false) {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  if (body?.name !== undefined) {
    const name = String(body.name).trim();
    if (!name) throw new HttpError(400, "Name is required");
    out.name = name.slice(0, 120);
  } else if (!partial) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Name is required");
  }

  if (body?.description !== undefined) {
    out.description = String(body.description).trim().slice(0, 300);
  }

  if (body?.priceInr !== undefined) {
    const price = Number(body.priceInr);
    if (!Number.isInteger(price) || price < 0) {
      throw new HttpError(400, "Price must be a whole number of paise");
    }
    out.priceInr = price;
  } else if (!partial) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Price is required");
  }

  if (body?.veg !== undefined) out.veg = Boolean(body.veg);
  if (body?.available !== undefined) out.available = Boolean(body.available);

  if (partial && Object.keys(out).length === 0) {
    throw new HttpError(400, "Nothing to update");
  }
  return out;
}

// All restaurants with their full menus, for the admin editor
adminMenuRouter.get("/restaurants", async (_req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const restaurants = await Restaurant.find().sort({ name: 1 }).lean();
    res.json({ restaurants });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

// Add a dish to a restaurant's menu
adminMenuRouter.post("/restaurants/:slug/menu", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const item = cleanItem(req.body);
    const restaurant = await Restaurant.findOneAndUpdate(
      { slug: req.params.slug },
      { $push: { menu: item } },
      { new: true },
    ).lean();
    if (!restaurant) throw new HttpError(404, "Restaurant not found");
    res.status(201).json({ restaurant });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

// Edit a dish, or toggle availability by sending { available }
adminMenuRouter.patch("/restaurants/:slug/menu/:itemId", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const { itemId } = req.params;
    if (!mongoose.isValidObjectId(itemId)) throw new HttpError(400, "Invalid item id");

    const changes = cleanItem(req.body, true);
    const $set = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(changes).map(([key, value]) => [`menu.$.${key}`, value]),
    );

    const restaurant = await Restaurant.findOneAndUpdate(
      { slug: req.params.slug, "menu._id": itemId },
      { $set },
      { new: true },
    ).lean();
    if (!restaurant) throw new HttpError(404, "Dish or restaurant not found");
    res.json({ restaurant });
  } catch (error) {
    next(error);
  }
});

    function startEdit(item) {
        setEditingId(item._id);
        setForm({
            name: item.name,

    async function handleSave(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!selected) return;
        const pricePaise = Math.round(Number(form.price) * 100);
        if (!form.name.trim() || !form.price.trim() || !Number.isFinite(pricePaise) || pricePaise < 0) {
            setError("Enter a dish name and a valid price.");
            return;
        }
        setSaving(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(editingId ? ITEM_URL(editingId) : ITEMS_URL(selected._id), {
                method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    name: form.name.trim(),
                    description: form.description.trim(),
                    category: form.category.trim(),
                    isVeg: form.isVeg,
                    pricePaise
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message ?? `Save failed (${res.status})`);
            cancelEdit();
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
        } finally{
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }
    async function toggleAvailability(item) {

            });
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Could not update availability");
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Update failed");
        }

    function startEdit(item) {
        setEditingId(item._id);
        setForm({
            name: item.name,
            description: item.description ?? "",
            category: item.category ?? "",
            price: String(item.pricePaise / 100),
            isVeg: !!item.isVeg
        });
    }
    function cancelEdit() {
        setEditingId(null);
        setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    }
    async function handleSave(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!selected) return;
        const pricePaise = Math.round(Number(form.price) * 100);
        if (!form.name.trim() || !form.price.trim() || !Number.isFinite(pricePaise) || pricePaise < 0) {
            setError("Enter a dish name and a valid price.");
            return;
        }
        setSaving(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(editingId ? ITEM_URL(editingId) : ITEMS_URL(selected._id), {
                method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    name: form.name.trim(),
                    description: form.description.trim(),
                    category: form.category.trim(),
                    isVeg: form.isVeg,
                    pricePaise
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message ?? `Save failed (${res.status})`);
            cancelEdit();
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
        } finally{
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }
    async function toggleAvailability(item) {
        setError(null);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(ITEM_URL(item._id), {
                method: "PATCH",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    isAvailable: !item.isAvailable
                })
            });
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Could not update availability");
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Update failed");
        }
    }

            description: item.description ?? "",
            category: item.category ?? "",
            price: String(item.pricePaise / 100),
            isVeg: !!item.isVeg
        });
    }
    function cancelEdit() {
        setEditingId(null);
        setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    }
    async function handleSave(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!selected) return;
        const pricePaise = Math.round(Number(form.price) * 100);
        if (!form.name.trim() || !form.price.trim() || !Number.isFinite(pricePaise) || pricePaise < 0) {
            setError("Enter a dish name and a valid price.");
            return;
        }
        setSaving(true);
        setError(null);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(editingId ? ITEM_URL(editingId) : ITEMS_URL(selected._id), {
                method: editingId ? "PATCH" : "POST",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    name: form.name.trim(),
                    description: form.description.trim(),
                    category: form.category.trim(),
                    isVeg: form.isVeg,
                    pricePaise
                })
            });
            const data = await res.json().catch(()=>({}));
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data?.message ?? `Save failed (${res.status})`);
            cancelEdit();
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Save failed");
        } finally{
            setSaving(false);
        }
    }
    async function toggleAvailability(item) {
        setError(null);
        try {
            const res = await fetch(ITEM_URL(item._id), {
                method: "PATCH",
                headers: {
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                },
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    isAvailable: !item.isAvailable
                })
            });
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Could not update availability");
            await load();
        } catch (err) {
            setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Update failed");
        }
    }

import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";

export type AdminOrder = {
  _id: string;
  restaurantSlug: string;
  mode: "delivery" | "pickup";
  status: string;
  address?: string;
  totalInr: number;
  createdAt: string;
  items: { menuItemName: string; quantity: number; priceInr: number }[];
  userId: { name: string; email: string; phone: string } | null;
};

export type AdminStats = {
  byStatus: Record<string, number>;
  total: number;
  today: { orders: number; revenueInr: number };
};

export const ORDER_STATUSES = ["received", "accepted", "preparing", "out-for-delivery", "delivered"];

// Mirrors the API rule: one step forward, and pickup orders skip out-for-delivery.
export function nextStatus(status: string, mode: "delivery" | "pickup"): string | null {
  const steps = mode === "pickup" ? ORDER_STATUSES.filter((s) => s !== "out-for-delivery") : ORDER_STATUSES;
  const i = steps.indexOf(status);
  return i === -1 ? null : (steps[i + 1] ?? null);
}

export const inr = (paise: number) => `₹${(paise / 100).toFixed(2)}`;

export const getAdminStats = () => api<AdminStats>("/admin/stats");

export const getAdminOrders = (status?: string) =>
  api<{ orders: AdminOrder[] }>(`/admin/orders${status ? `?status=${encodeURIComponent(status)}` : ""}`);

export const setOrderStatus = (id: string, status: string) =>
  api<{ order: AdminOrder }>(`/admin/orders/${id}/status`, { method: "PATCH", body: { status } });

export type AdminOffer = {
  _id: string;
  code: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  type: "percent" | "fixed";
  value: number;
  minSubtotalInr: number;
  maxDiscountInr?: number;
  active: boolean;
};

export const getAdminOffers = () => api<{ offers: AdminOffer[] }>("/admin/offers");

export const createOffer = (body: Record<string, unknown>) =>
  api<{ offer: AdminOffer }>("/admin/offers", { body });

export const setOfferActive = (id: string, active: boolean) =>
  api<{ offer: AdminOffer }>(`/admin/offers/${id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: { active } });

"use client";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { getAdminOffers, getAdminOrders, inr } from "./admin.api";
import styles from "./admin-dashboard.module.css";

type Row = {
  _id: string;
  status: string;
  totalInr: number;
  mode: string;
  createdAt: string;
  userId?: { name?: string } | null;
  restaurantName?: string;
};

type Offer = { _id: string; code: string; title: string; active: boolean };

const GROUPS = [
  { key: "pending", label: "Pending", color: "#f59e0b", match: ["placed", "accepted"] },
  { key: "preparing", label: "Preparing", color: "#fb923c", match: ["preparing"] },
  { key: "out", label: "Out for delivery", color: "#3b82f6", match: ["out-for-delivery"] },
  { key: "delivered", label: "Delivered", color: "#16a34a", match: ["delivered"] },
  { key: "cancelled", label: "Cancelled", color: "#dc2626", match: ["cancelled"] },
];

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  placed: "Pending",
  accepted: "Pending",
  preparing: "Preparing",
  "out-for-delivery": "Out for delivery",
  delivered: "Delivered",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

const badgeClass = (status: string) => {
  if (status === "delivered") return styles.ok;
  if (status === "cancelled") return styles.bad;
  if (status === "out-for-delivery") return styles.info;
  return styles.warn;
};

const timeOf = (iso: string) =>
  new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-IN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });

const today = () =>
  new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });

export function AdminDashboard() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [offers, setOffers] = useState<Offer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const [o, f] = await Promise.all([getAdminOrders(), getAdminOffers()]);
        if (!alive) return;
        setOrders(o.orders as unknown as Row[]);
        setOffers(f.offers as unknown as Offer[]);
        setError("");
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Admin dashboard load failed:", e);
        if (alive) setError("Could not load the dashboard.");
      } finally {
        if (alive) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
    const timer = setInterval(load, 10000);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const live = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled");
    return {
      total: orders.length,
      revenue: live.reduce((sum, o) => sum + o.totalInr, 0),
      active: orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "delivered" && o.status !== "cancelled").length,
      customers: new Set(orders.map((o) => o.userId?.name ?? o._id)).size,
    };
  }, [orders]);

  const groups = useMemo(
    () => GROUPS.map((g) => ({ ...g, count: orders.filter((o) => g.match.includes(o.status)).length })),
    [orders]
  );

  const days = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { label: string; key: string; total: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date();
      d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      out.push({
        label: d.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "2-digit", month: "short" }),
        key: d.toDateString(),
        total: 0,
      });
    }
    orders.forEach((o) => {
      if (o.status === "cancelled") return;
      const day = out.find((x) => x.key === new Date(o.createdAt).toDateString());
      if (day) day.total += o.totalInr;
    });
    return out;
  }, [orders]);

  const maxDay = Math.max(1, ...days.map((d) => d.total));
  const recent = orders.slice(0, 6);
  const activeOffers = offers.filter((o) => o.active).length;

  const R = 60;
  const C = 2 * Math.PI * R;
  const totalForDonut = groups.reduce((s, g) => s + g.count, 0);

  if (error) return <div className={styles.state}>{error}</div>;

  return (
    <section>
      <div className={styles.welcome}>
        <div>
          <h1 className={styles.title}>Welcome back, Admin!</h1>

        </div>
        <span className={styles.dateChip}>{today()}</span>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.stats}>
        <div className={styles.stat}>
          <div className={styles.statIcon}>#</div>
          <div>
            <p className={styles.statLabel}>Total orders</p>
            <p className={styles.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.total.toLocaleString("en-IN")}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.stat}>
          <div className={styles.statIcon}>â‚¹</div>
          <div>
            <p className={styles.statLabel}>Total revenue</p>
            <p className={styles.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : inr(stats.revenue)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.stat}>
          <div className={styles.statIcon}>â—·</div>
          <div>

        </div>
        <div className={styles.stat}>

                {(() => {

                    const len = totalForDonut ? (g.count / totalForDonut) * C : 0;

                      <circle

                    acc += len;

"use client";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { getAdminOffers, inr } from "./admin.api";
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import shared from "./admin-dashboard.module.css";
import styles from "./admin-offers.module.css";

type Offer = {
  _id: string;
  code: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  type: "percent" | "flat";
  value: number; // percent points, or paise for flat
  minSubtotalInr?: number; // paise
  maxDiscountInr?: number; // paise
  active: boolean;
};

type Filter = "all" | "active" | "off";

const discountText = (o: Offer) =>
  o.type === "percent" ? `${o.value}% off` : `${inr(o.value)} off`;

export function AdminOffers() {
  const [offers, setOffers] = useState<Offer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rowError, setRowError] = useState("");

  // Form state
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState<"percent" | "flat">("percent");
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [minOrder, setMinOrder] = useState("");
  const [maxDiscount, setMaxDiscount] = useState("");
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState("");
  const [formNotice, setFormNotice] = useState("");

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getAdminOffers();
      setOffers(data.offers as unknown as Offer[]);
      setError("");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Admin offers load failed:", e);
      setError("Could not load offers.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const stats = useMemo(
    () => ({
      total: offers.length,
      active: offers.filter((o) => o.active).length,
      off: offers.filter((o) => !o.active).length,
      percent: offers.filter((o) => o.type === "percent").length,
    }),
    [offers]
  );

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return offers.filter((o) => {
      if (filter === "active" && !o.active) return false;
      if (filter === "off" && o.active) return false;
      if (q && !`${o.code} ${o.title}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [offers, filter, search]);

  const toggle = async (o: Offer) => {
    setBusyId(o._id);
    setRowError("");
    try {
      await api(`/admin/offers/${o._id}`, { method: "PATCH", body: { active: !o.active } });
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setRowError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not update the coupon.");
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  };

  const onCreate = async (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError("");
    setFormNotice("");
    const numValue = Number(value);
    if (!code.trim() || !title.trim() || !numValue) {
      setFormError("Enter a code, a title, and a discount value.");
      return;
    }
    // Rupee inputs become paise for flat discounts and order limits
    const body = {
      code: code.trim().toUpperCase(),
      title: title.trim(),
      type,
      value: type === "flat" ? Math.round(numValue * 100) : numValue,
      minSubtotalInr: minOrder ? Math.round(Number(minOrder) * 100) : undefined,
      maxDiscountInr: maxDiscount ? Math.round(Number(maxDiscount) * 100) : undefined,
      active: true,
    };
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      await api("/admin/offers", { method: "POST", body });
      setFormNotice(`Created ${body.code}.`);
      setCode("");
      setTitle("");
      setValue("");
      setMinOrder("");
      setMaxDiscount("");
      await load();
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not create the coupon.");
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section>
      <div className={shared.welcome}>
        <div>
          <h1 className={shared.title}>Offers &amp; coupons</h1>
          <p className={shared.subtitle}>Create promotions and manage discounts.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={shared.stats}>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>%</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Total offers</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.total}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>âœ“</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Active offers</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.active}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â—Œ</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Switched off</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.off}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â‚¹</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Flat vs percent</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>
              {loading ? "â€¦" : `${stats.percent} / ${stats.total - stats.percent}`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <div className={shared.state} style={{ marginTop: "1rem" }}>{error}</div>}

      <div className={styles.layout}>
        <div className={shared.card}>
          <div className={styles.tabs}>
            {(
              [
                { key: "all", label: `All (${stats.total})` },
                { key: "active", label: `Active (${stats.active})` },
                { key: "off", label: `Off (${stats.off})` },
              ] as { key: Filter; label: string }[]
            ).map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.key}
                className={`${styles.tab} ${filter === t.key ? styles.tabActive : ""}`}
                onClick={() => setFilter(t.key)}
              >
                {t.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className={styles.toolbar}>
            <input
              className={styles.search}
              type="search"
              placeholder="Search by code or title"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          {rowError && <p className={styles.error} style={{ marginBottom: "0.6rem" }}>{rowError}</p>}

          {!loading && visible.length === 0 && (
            <p className={shared.muted}>No offers match these filters.</p>
          )}

          {visible.length > 0 && (
            <table className={shared.table}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Offer</th>
                  <th>Code</th>
                  <th>Discount</th>
                  <th>Min order</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {visible.map((o) => (
                  <tr key={o._id}>
                    <td>
                      <strong>{o.title}</strong>
                      {o.description && <p className={shared.muted} style={{ margin: 0 }}>{o.description}</p>}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={styles.code}>{o.code}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td>{discountText(o)}</td>
                    <td>{o.minSubtotalInr ? inr(o.minSubtotalInr) : "None"}</td>
                    <td>
                      <button
                        className={`${styles.switch} ${o.active ? styles.switchOn : ""}`}
                        onClick={() => toggle(o)}
                        disabled={busyId === o._id}
                        aria-pressed={o.active}
                        aria-label={`${o.active ? "Switch off" : "Switch on"} ${o.code}`}
                      />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          )}
        </div>

        <aside className={shared.card}>
          <h2 className={shared.cardTitle} style={{ marginBottom: "0.9rem" }}>Create new offer</h2>
          <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={onCreate}>
            <label className={styles.field}>
              Offer name
              <input className={styles.input} value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Flat 20% off" />
            </label>
            <div className={styles.row2}>
              <label className={styles.field}>
                Coupon code
                <input className={styles.input} value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} placeholder="e.g. BITE20" />
              </label>
              <label className={styles.field}>
                Discount type
                <select className={styles.select} value={type} onChange={(e) => setType(e.target.value as "percent" | "flat")}>
                  <option value="percent">Percent off</option>
                  <option value="flat">Flat amount (â‚¹)</option>
                </select>
              </label>
            </div>
            <label className={styles.field}>
              {type === "percent" ? "Discount (%)" : "Discount (â‚¹)"}
              <input className={styles.input} type="number" min="1" value={value} onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)} />
            </label>
            <div className={styles.row2}>
              <label className={styles.field}>

"use client";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { getAdminOrders, inr } from "./admin.api";
import { api } from "@/lib/api/client";
import shared from "./admin-dashboard.module.css";
import styles from "./admin-orders.module.css";

type Row = {
  _id: string;
  status: string;
  totalInr: number;
  mode: "delivery" | "pickup";
  createdAt: string;
  userId?: { name?: string; phone?: string; email?: string } | null;
  restaurantName?: string;
  items?: { menuItemName: string; priceInr: number; quantity: number }[];
  address?: string;
  couponCode?: string;
  discountInr?: number;
};

const LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  placed: "Pending",
  accepted: "Accepted",
  preparing: "Preparing",
  "out-for-delivery": "Out for delivery",
  delivered: "Delivered",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

const TABS = [
  { key: "all", label: "All", match: null },
  { key: "pending", label: "Pending", match: ["placed", "accepted"] },
  { key: "preparing", label: "Preparing", match: ["preparing"] },
  { key: "out", label: "Out for delivery", match: ["out-for-delivery"] },
  { key: "delivered", label: "Delivered", match: ["delivered"] },
  { key: "cancelled", label: "Cancelled", match: ["cancelled"] },
] as const;

// Next status, skipping "out-for-delivery" for pickup orders
const nextStatus = (o: Row): string | null => {
  switch (o.status) {
    case "placed":
      return "accepted";
    case "accepted":
      return "preparing";
    case "preparing":
      return o.mode === "pickup" ? "delivered" : "out-for-delivery";
    case "out-for-delivery":
      return "delivered";
    default:
      return null;
  }
};

const badgeClass = (status: string) => {
  if (status === "delivered") return shared.ok;
  if (status === "cancelled") return shared.bad;
  if (status === "out-for-delivery") return shared.info;
  return shared.warn;
};

const timeOf = (iso: string) =>
  new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-IN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });

const shortId = (id: string) => id.slice(-8).toUpperCase();

export function AdminOrders() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<(typeof TABS)[number]["key"]>("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [modeFilter, setModeFilter] = useState<"all" | "delivery" | "pickup">("all");
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState("");

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getAdminOrders();
      setOrders(data.orders as unknown as Row[]);
      setError("");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Admin orders load failed:", e);
      setError("Could not load orders.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    const timer = setInterval(load, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const c: Record<string, number> = {};
    TABS.forEach((t) => {
      c[t.key] = t.match
        ? orders.filter((o) => (t.match as readonly string[]).includes(o.status)).length
        : orders.length;
    });
    return c;
  }, [orders]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const live = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled");
    return {
      total: orders.length,
      pending: counts.pending,
            preparing: (counts.preparing ?? 0) + (counts.out ?? 0),
      completed: counts.delivered,
      revenue: live.reduce((s, o) => s + o.totalInr, 0),
    };
  }, [orders, counts]);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const tabDef = TABS.find((t) => t.key === tab);
    return orders.filter((o) => {
      if (tabDef?.match && !(tabDef.match as readonly string[]).includes(o.status)) return false;
      if (modeFilter !== "all" && o.mode !== modeFilter) return false;
      if (q) {
        const hay = [
          shortId(o._id),
          o.userId?.name ?? "",
          o.userId?.phone ?? "",
          o.restaurantName ?? "",
        ]
          .join(" ")
          .toLowerCase();
        if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [orders, tab, search, modeFilter]);

  const selected = orders.find((o) => o._id === selectedId) ?? null;
  const next = selected ? nextStatus(selected) : null;

  const advance = async () => {
    if (!selected || !next) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setActionError("");
    try {
      await api(`/admin/orders/${selected._id}/status`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: { status: next },
      });
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setActionError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not update the order.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section>
      <div className={shared.welcome}>
        <div>
          <h1 className={shared.title}>Order management</h1>
          <p className={shared.subtitle}>Manage and monitor all customer orders.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={shared.stats}>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>#</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Total orders</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.total}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â—·</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Pending</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.pending}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â™¨</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>In progress</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.preparing}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>âœ“</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>Completed</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{loading ? "â€¦" : stats.completed}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && <div className={shared.state} style={{ marginTop: "1rem" }}>{error}</div>}

      <div className={styles.layout}>
        <div className={shared.card}>
          <div className={styles.tabs}>
            {TABS.map((t) => (
              <button
                key={t.key}
                className={`${styles.tab} ${tab === t.key ? styles.tabActive : ""}`}
                onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
              >
                {t.label} ({counts[t.key] ?? 0})
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className={styles.toolbar}>
            <input
              className={styles.search}
              type="search"
              placeholder="Search order ID, customer, phone, or restaurant"
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            />
            <select
              className={styles.select}
              value={modeFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setModeFilter(e.target.value as "all" | "delivery" | "pickup")}
            >
              <option value="all">All types</option>
              <option value="delivery">Delivery</option>
              <option value="pickup">Pickup</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {!loading && visible.length === 0 && (
            <p className={shared.muted}>No orders match these filters.</p>
          )}

          {visible.length > 0 && (
            <table className={shared.table}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Order ID</th>
                  <th>Customer</th>
                  <th>Restaurant</th>
                  <th>Time</th>
                  <th>Total</th>
                  <th>Type</th>
                  <th>Status</th>
                  <th></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {visible.map((o) => (
                  <tr
                    key={o._id}
                    className={o._id === selectedId ? styles.rowActive : undefined}
                  >

                        {LABEL[o.status] ?? o.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td>

                        View
                      </button>

                ))}

import Link from "next/link";

const offerText = (o: AdminOffer) =>
  o.type === "percent" ? `${o.value}% off` : `${inr(o.value)} off`;

export function AdminOverview() {

  const [offers, setOffers] = useState<AdminOffer[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

import { getAdminOffers, getAdminOrders, inr } from "./admin.api";
import shared from "./admin-dashboard.module.css";
import styles from "./admin-profile.module.css";

type Row = {
  _id: string;
  status: string;
  totalInr: number;
  createdAt: string;
  restaurantName?: string;
  userId?: { name?: string } | null;
};

type Offer = { _id: string; active: boolean };

const ACTIVE_STATUSES = ["placed", "accepted", "preparing", "out-for-delivery"];

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  placed: "Pending",
  accepted: "Accepted",
  preparing: "Preparing",
  "out-for-delivery": "Out for delivery",
  delivered: "Delivered",
  cancelled: "Cancelled",
};

const isToday = (iso: string) => new Date(iso).toDateString() === new Date().toDateString();
const timeOf = (iso: string) =>
  new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-IN", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });

export function AdminProfile() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<PublicUser | null>(null);
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [offers, setOffers] = useState<Offer[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [resendBusy, setResendBusy] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = async () => {
      try {
        const me = await getMe();
        if (!alive) return;
        setUser(me);

        // allSettled: one failing request should not hide the whole profile
        const [o, f] = await Promise.allSettled([getAdminOrders(), getAdminOffers()]);
        if (!alive) return;
        if (o.status === "fulfilled") setOrders(o.value.orders as unknown as Row[]);
        if (f.status === "fulfilled") setOffers(f.value.offers as unknown as Offer[]);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Profile load failed:", e);
        if (alive) setError("Could not load your profile.");
      } finally {
        if (alive) setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    load();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const live = orders.filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled");
    return {
      ordersToday: orders.filter((o) => isToday(o.createdAt)).length,
      inProgress: orders.filter((o) => ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(o.status)).length,
      delivered: orders.filter((o) => o.status === "delivered").length,
      revenue: live.reduce((s, o) => s + o.totalInr, 0),
      activeOffers: offers.filter((o) => o.active).length,
    };
  }, [orders, offers]);

  const recent = orders.slice(0, 5);

  const copyEmail = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(user.email);
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
    } catch {
      setCopied(false);
    }
  };

  const onResend = async () => {
    if (!user) return;
    setResendBusy(true);
    setNotice("");
    try {
      const data = await resendVerification(user.email);
      setNotice(data.message);
    } catch (e) {
      setNotice(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not send the email.");
    } finally {
      setResendBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className={shared.state}>Loading profile...</div>;
  if (error || !user) return <div className={shared.state}>{error || "Profile not found."}</div>;

  const initial = user.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <section>
      <div className={shared.welcome}>
        <div>
          <h1 className={shared.title}>My profile</h1>
          <p className={shared.subtitle}>Your account, your activity, and quick access to admin tools.</p>
        </div>
        <LogoutButton className={styles.logout} />
      </div>

      {!user.emailVerified && (
        <div className={styles.warnBanner}>
          <div>
            <strong>Your email is not verified.</strong>
            <p className={shared.muted} style={{ margin: "0.2rem 0 0" }}>
              Verify it to protect your admin account.
            </p>
          </div>
          <button className={styles.btnSolid} onClick={onResend} disabled={resendBusy}>
            {resendBusy ? "Sending..." : "Resend verification"}
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
      {notice && <p className={styles.notice}>{notice}</p>}

      <div className={shared.card}>
        <div className={styles.head}>
          <div className={styles.avatar}>{initial}</div>
          <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 220 }}>
            <p className={styles.name}>{user.name}</p>
            <p className={styles.email}>
              {user.email}
              <button className={styles.copy} onClick={copyEmail}>
                {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
              </button>
            </p>
            <div className={styles.tags}>
              <span className={`${shared.badge} ${shared.info}`}>Administrator</span>
              <span className={`${shared.badge} ${user.emailVerified ? shared.ok : shared.warn}`}>
                {user.emailVerified ? "Email verified" : "Email not verified"}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={styles.stats}>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>#</div>
          <div>

          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â—·</div>
          <div>
            <p className={shared.statLabel}>In progress</p>
            <p className={shared.statValue}>{stats.inProgress}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={shared.stat}>
          <div className={shared.statIcon}>â‚¹</div>

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import styles from "@/features/auth/auth.module.css";
import { getAdminStats, inr, type AdminStats } from "./admin.api";

export function AdminStatsCards() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<AdminStats | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const load = () =>
      getAdminStats()
        .then((s) => alive && setStats(s))
        .catch((e: unknown) => alive && setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Could not load stats"));
    load();
    const timer = setInterval(load, 10000);
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  if (error) return <p className={styles.error}>{error}</p>;
  if (!stats) return <p className={styles.muted}>Loading stats...</p>;

  const active = stats.total - (stats.byStatus["delivered"] ?? 0);
  const cards: [string, string][] = [
    ["Orders today", String(stats.today.orders)],
    ["Revenue today", inr(stats.today.revenueInr)],
    ["Active orders", String(active)],
    ["Delivered (all time)", String((stats.byStatus["delivered"] ?? 0))],
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.grid}>
        {cards.map(([label, value]) => (
          <div className={styles.card} key={label}>
            <p className={styles.muted}>{label}</p>
            <h2>{value}</h2>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className={styles.muted}>
        {Object.entries(stats.byStatus)
          .map(([s, n]) => `${s}: ${n}`)
          .join("  ·  ")}
      </p>
    </>
  );
}

const express = require("express");
const mongoose = require("mongoose");
const { requireAuth } = require("../middleware/auth");

const router = express.Router();
const { ObjectId } = mongoose.Types;
const FLOW = ["placed", "confirmed", "preparing", "ready", "out_for_delivery", "delivered"];

const db = () => mongoose.connection.db;

// Only customers whose role is "admin" get through.
async function requireAdmin(req, res, next) {
  try {
    const c = await db().collection("customers").findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(req.customerId) });
    if (!c || c.role !== "admin") return res.status(403).json({ message: "Admins only" });
    next();
  } catch {
    res.status(403).json({ message: "Admins only" });
  }
}

router.use(requireAuth, requireAdmin);

// GET /api/admin/orders?status=&q=
router.get("/orders", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const filter = {};
    if (req.query.status && req.query.status !== "all") filter.status = String(req.query.status);
    const q = String(req.query.q || "").trim();
    if (q) {
      const rx = new RegExp(q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"), "i");
      filter.$or = [{ "customer.name": rx }, { "customer.phone": rx }, { restaurantName: rx }];
      if (ObjectId.isValid(q)) filter.$or.push({ _id: new ObjectId(q) });
    }
    const orders = await db().collection("orders_v2").find(filter).sort({ createdAt: -1 }).limit(300).toArray();
    res.json({ data: orders });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin orders failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not load orders" });
  }
});

// PATCH /api/admin/orders/:id/status  body: { status }  (one step forward only)
router.patch("/orders/:id/status", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    if (!ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id)) return res.status(400).json({ message: "Invalid id" });
    const _id = new ObjectId(req.params.id);
    const order = await db().collection("orders_v2").findOne({ _id });
    if (!order) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Order not found" });
    const i = FLOW.indexOf(order.status);
    const next = FLOW[i + 1];
    if (!next || req.body?.status !== next) {
      return res.status(400).json({ message: "This order cannot move to that status yet" });
    }
    const now = new Date();
    await db().collection("orders_v2").updateOne(
      { _id },
      { $set: { status: next, updatedAt: now }, $push: { statusHistory: { status: next, at: now } } }
    );
    res.json({ ok: true, status: next });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin status failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not update the order" });
  }
});

// PATCH /api/admin/orders/:id/cancel  body: { reason }
router.patch("/orders/:id/cancel", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    if (!ObjectId.isValid(req.params.id)) return res.status(400).json({ message: "Invalid id" });
    const _id = new ObjectId(req.params.id);
    const order = await db().collection("orders_v2").findOne({ _id });
    if (!order) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Order not found" });
    if (order.status === "delivered" || order.status === "cancelled") {
      return res.status(400).json({ message: "This order can no longer be cancelled" });
    }
    const now = new Date();
    const reason = String(req.body?.reason || "Cancelled by restaurant").slice(0, 120);
    await db().collection("orders_v2").updateOne(
      { _id },
      { $set: { status: "cancelled", cancelReason: reason, updatedAt: now }, $push: { statusHistory: { status: "cancelled", at: now } } }
    );
    res.json({ ok: true, status: "cancelled" });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin cancel failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not cancel the order" });
  }
});

// GET /api/admin/menu : every dish from every restaurant
router.get("/menu", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rs = await db().collection("restaurants").find({}).toArray();
    const items = [];
    for (const r of rs) {
      for (const m of r.menu || []) {
        items.push({
          id: String(m._id),
          restaurantId: String(r._id),
          restaurantName: r.name,
          name: m.name,
          price: m.price,
          veg: m.veg ?? null,
          available: m.available !== false,
          featured: m.featured === true,
        });
      }
    }
    res.json({ data: items });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin menu failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not load the menu" });
  }
});

// PATCH /api/admin/menu/:itemId  body: { available?, featured? }
router.patch("/menu/:itemId", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    if (!ObjectId.isValid(req.params.itemId)) return res.status(400).json({ message: "Invalid id" });
    const set = {};
    if (typeof req.body?.available === "boolean") set["menu.$.available"] = req.body.available;
    if (typeof req.body?.featured === "boolean") set["menu.$.featured"] = req.body.featured;
    if (Object.keys(set).length === 0) return res.status(400).json({ message: "Nothing to change" });
    const r = await db().collection("restaurants").updateOne({ "menu._id": new ObjectId(req.params.itemId) }, { $set: set });
    if (r.matchedCount === 0) return res.status(404).json({ message: "Dish not found" });
    res.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin menu update failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not update the dish" });
  }
});

// GET /api/admin/stats
router.get("/stats", async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const orders = db().collection("orders_v2");
    const start = new Date();
    start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const byStatus = {};
    for (const s of [...FLOW, "cancelled"]) byStatus[s] = await orders.countDocuments({ status: s });
    const today = await orders.find({ createdAt: { $gte: start } }).toArray();
    const revenue = today.filter((o) => o.status !== "cancelled").reduce((n, o) => n + (o.total || 0), 0);
    const rs = await db().collection("restaurants").find({}).toArray();
    const dishes = rs.flatMap((r) => r.menu || []);
    res.json({
      data: {
        totalOrders: Object.values(byStatus).reduce((n, v) => n + v, 0),
        byStatus,
        todayOrders: today.length,
        todayRevenue: revenue,
        dishesTotal: dishes.length,
        dishesUnavailable: dishes.filter((m) => m.available === false).length,
      },
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("admin stats failed:", err.message);
    res.status(500).json({ message: "Could not load stats" });
  }
});

module.exports = router;

require("dotenv").config();
const mongoose = require("mongoose");
(async () => {
  const email = (process.argv[2] || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!email) { console.log("Usage: node set-admin.js your@email.com"); process.exit(1); }
  await mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGO_URI);
  const r = await mongoose.connection.db.collection("customers").updateOne({ email }, { $set: { role: "admin" } });
  console.log(r.matchedCount ? "Admin role set for " + email : "No account with that email. Sign up first.");
  await mongoose.disconnect();
})().catch((e) => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); });
